exposure: Parity (nulligravidas, parous women with vaginal delivery, parous women with elective caesarean)
parous women with elective caesarean-delivery without any previous labour or cervix dilation
parous women with previous vaginal delivery
cohort: 413 women aged 15-49 years who opted for LNG-IUS placement for contraception or treatment of heavy menstrual bleeding
finding: Women with previous vaginal delivery experienced lower pain scores during LNG-IUS insertion compared to nulligravidas and women who had undergone elective caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with a history of vaginal delivery experienced lower pain scores during LNG-IUS insertion compared to nulligravidas and those who had elective caesarean deliveries.
